summary: Table Trac Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a Board-declared cash dividend of $0.02 per share, payable June 12, 2026 to holders of record May 29, 2026. The dividend reflects disciplined capital allocation and returning value to shareholders. No premium, stake, advisors, or other deal terms were disclosed. The filing is a routine capital return event, not a special situation warranting a different category. Watch for continued quarterly dividends or changes in payout policy.
